technical_requirements:
Indexing scale: targeting 700k initial vectors, plan to grow to 3-5M vectors within 12 months. Re-index pattern: daily incremental embeddings pushed via CI, weekly full re-index. Query profile: developer queries (short prompts, median token length 12), peak QPS 120, sustained 30-50 QPS. Latency targets: median <75ms, p95 <220ms, p99 <450ms for end-to-end (embedding + ANN lookup + rerank). Reranking: neural re-ranker stage applied to top-50 candidates; additional feature joins (file metadata, last-modified, owner signals). Cost goals: budget-aware — target <$0.004 per query at 1M index size with batching and KV cache. Data controls: must support per-tenant data residency, envelope encryption with customer-managed KMS, audit logs for query/edit events. SSO: Okta + SAML 2.0 with attribute mappings. Integration hooks: streaming responses not required, but websocket for long-running re-ranks desired.

Notes on perf knobs considered: chunking strategies (repo-level vs file-level), quantized embeddings (8-bit) for storage, tiered ANN (RAM-hot indices for recent commits + disk-cold archive), smart routing to cheaper models for low-priority background jobs.
